steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Step your left foot outside your left hand, knee over ankle. Keep your right leg long.

steps.title: Lower
steps.instruction: Plant your right hand. Exhale and lower your left elbow inside your left foot.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.instruction: Inhale. Open your chest left and reach your left hand up. Follow it with your eyes.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Start on hands and knees. Put your hands under your shoulders.

steps.title: Thread
steps.instruction: Exhale. Slide your left arm under your right arm, palm up.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Rest your left shoulder and ear on the mat. Keep your hips over your knees and breathe.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Sit tall with both sit bones down. Bend your knees and plant your feet.

steps.title: Front leg
steps.instruction: Lower your left knee in front. Bend it to 90 degrees with your calf on the floor.

steps.title: Back leg
steps.instruction: Take your right thigh out to the side. Bend the knee to 90 degrees, with the lower leg pointing back.

steps.title: Lean
steps.instruction: Lengthen your spine. Hinge over your front shin and breathe.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Lie on your back with your arms beside you, palms down.

steps.title: Lift
steps.instruction: Bring your legs up together. Keep your head still.

steps.title: Roll
steps.instruction: Slowly roll your hips up and carry your legs overhead. Do not swing.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Rest your toes on the floor or a support. Keep weight on your upper back, not your neck. Breathe.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Kneel on your right knee under your hip. Place your left knee over your ankle.

steps.title: Tuck
steps.instruction: Tuck your tailbone. Gently squeeze your right glute and keep your ribs down.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Stay tall. Shift your hips slightly forward and breathe.

steps.title: Stand
steps.instruction: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.

steps.title: Fold
steps.instruction: Hinge at your hips with a long spine. Keep your knees soft and reach for your shins or the floor.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Relax your neck and breathe slowly. Keep a small bend in your knees.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Stand hip-width. Hinge forward and plant your hands on the floor or blocks.

steps.title: Bend one knee
steps.instruction: Keep your hands still. Lift your left heel and bend your left knee. Lengthen your right leg.

steps.title: Switch
steps.instruction: Lower your left heel as you lift your right heel and bend your right knee. Breathe with each switch.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Start on hands and knees. Keep your knees and feet hip-width, with the tops of your feet down.

steps.title: Round
steps.instruction: Exhale. Push the floor away, round your spine, and tuck your chin and tailbone gently.

steps.title: Arch
steps.instruction: Inhale. Lift your tailbone, lower your belly, and open your chest. Gaze ahead.

steps.title: Stand
steps.instruction: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down.

steps.title: Reach back
steps.instruction: Bend your left elbow. Rest the back of your hand on your sacrum and keep the elbow close.

steps.title: Slide up
steps.instruction: Slide your hand a little way up your low back. Breathe and stop at a mild pull.
